ns2:section.sectionText: Chainsaw Safety & Direction Felling Techniques will provide NRES undergraduate students with instruction and hands-on training specific to gasoline-powered chainsaw safety, saw maintenance, directional felling, limbing, and bucking. The class will meet at the Illini Experimental Forest (2711 S. Race St., Urbana, IL) during spring break (March 13-17, 2023). Students are responsible for their own transportation, meals, and lodging during this week-long course. Additionally, all students are required to supply their own 8” leather work boots and leather/Mechanic’s gloves. Students who successfully complete this course will be awarded with a “Safety and Woods Worker Training Certificate: Levels 1-2.” There is no field trip fee for this section. A time conflict override is needed to register for this section. Please complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist to request a time conflict override or to be added to the waiting list.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
